Blocks.Text: This FAQ covers answers to commonly asked questions about integrating with Analytics Services.

Blocks.Section: How often does the data refresh?
SectionPath: How often does the data refresh?
Blocks.Text: We refresh data once every 24 hours.

Blocks.Section: What is the maximum time period that I can query data for?
SectionPath: What is the maximum time period that I can query data for?
Blocks.Text: An individual query can have a time range of up to 90 days.

Blocks.Section: Can I filter or choose which fields I'd like to export?
SectionPath: Can I filter or choose which fields I'd like to export?
Blocks.Text: No, you can't choose specific fields to export at this time. You'll receive all exported fields in each request.

Blocks.Section: How can I reduce the file size of the results?
SectionPath: How can I reduce the file size of the results?
Blocks.Text: Request data for a shorter time period.

Blocks.Section: How much time do I have to download data?
SectionPath: How much time do I have to download data?
Blocks.Text: We keep all files generated in last 7 days. The download URL will live for 1 hour starting from the time it's created. Once expired (within 7 days), users can initiate a GET request for the export job id again and receive a new download URL.

Blocks.Section: How are multiple query requests handled?
SectionPath: How are multiple query requests handled?
Blocks.Text: Only one query can be in progress at a time, per endpoint, per contract. If an additional query request is made for an endpoint, it will be enqueued until the previous request for that endpoint is completed.

Blocks.Section: What is the maximum size of the download file?
SectionPath: What is the maximum size of the download file?
Blocks.Text: The maximum file size is 3 GB.

Blocks.Section: What is the criteria for a valid time range?
SectionPath: What is the criteria for a valid time range?
Blocks.Text: Criteria for valid range can be found exportActivityData
